title: A Menswork website's Home and Calendar page show the Space's Frequency calendar, and the menu's admin links are plain blue text

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-08: 'I wanted the Hearts on Fire Frequency calendar on the main home page, not the admin version. Instad of a blue banner in the menu for admin. Just make those links blue  Admin: Exectutive Overview | Yearly Calendar', clarified as 'the Space's own Frequency calendar, the events attached to the Hearts on Fire Space'.

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-08. SitePublicCalendar renders the Space's Calendar tab as a visitor sees it (the guest half of app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/(profile)/calendar/page.tsx): CalendarWorkspace with adminAllowed false over loadPublicSpaceWindow and loadSpaceUpcomingFeed, with the Up next band, the month grid and the subscribe menu, browsing months through loadSpaceCalendarMonth. Home ends with it in the site container; the calendar page gives it an h1 from the page label. readSitePublicYear (the admin calendar's look over public events) is removed. The header's admin links lose the signal-colour banner: 'Admin:' and the two links are blue text with a '|' between them. The footer admin section is unchanged. HOTFIX 2026-10-08: the first deploy 500'd every Menswork website (Page changed from static to dynamic, reason: cookies), because loadPublicSpaceWindow's listPublicUnavailableItems read space_public_unavailable through the cookie client inside the cached, viewer-free site render. That RPC is granted to anon and answers alike for every caller, so it now goes through createPublicClient (lib/supabase/public.ts); the probe checks it.

2026-10-10: the website header moved into components/sites/house-header.tsx (header handoff v5: one-line scrolling menu, two-row phone layout, mega panels, fade on pause). The probe reads site-chrome.tsx and house-header.tsx together; the consequence is unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const cal=r('components/sites/site-public-calendar.tsx');if(!/<CalendarWorkspace/.test(cal)||!/adminAllowed=\{false\}/.test(cal))miss.push('the website calendar is not the Frequency calendar');if(/readSitePublicYear/.test(cal+r('lib/sites/site-admin.ts')))miss.push('the admin-look public year is still there');const css=r('components/sites/menswork-css.ts');const rule=(css.match(/\.hs-nav \.hs-nav-admin\{[^}]*\}/)||[''])[0];if(!rule||/background/.test(rule))miss.push('the menu admin links still sit on a banner');if(!/hs-nav-admin-sep/.test((r('components/sites/site-chrome.tsx')+r('components/sites/house-header.tsx'))))miss.push('no separator between the admin links');const ent=r('lib/calendar/entries-store.ts');const fn=ent.slice(ent.indexOf('export async function listPublicUnavailableItems'));if(!/createPublicClient\(\)/.test(fn.slice(0,fn.indexOf('\n}'))))miss.push('the public unavailable read still uses the cookie client, so a cached website render 500s');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-872: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Re-pointed 2026-10-10: the house header markup moved from site-chrome.tsx into house-header.tsx (header handoff v5), so the probe reads both.
